items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...who's the tenor player? Hafer >> [INTERVIEWEE] Dick Haneford.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember that -- seeing that band maybe five or six times, at least that many times, down at the Vanguard. I was absolutely knocked out with it. And Jerome Richardson and -- I remember, Richard Williams and Rolf Ericson and Charlie Mariano and -- who's the tenor player? Hafer

Dick Hafer, yeah. He didn't play M. BASS CLARINET. any solos, he just had to play parts, mostly. And, boy, that was -- that just blew me away. And the trombone player was Butter, wasn't it? [Quentin JACKSON ed. note]
